categories.main_business_segments: Fortune Brands Innovations operates two primary business segments following the December 2022 spin-off of its Cabinets business. The Water Innovations segment manufactures and sells faucets, accessories, kitchen sinks, and waste disposals under brands including Moen, ROHL, Riobel, Victoria+Albert, Perrin & Rowe, Aqualisa, and Shaws. The Outdoors & Security segment manufactures and sells fiberglass and steel entry door systems (Therma-Tru), storm and security doors (Larson), composite decking and railing (Fiberon), urethane millwork (Fypon), and locks and security devices (Master Lock, American Lock, SentrySafe).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs manufacturing and assembly processes for plumbing fixtures and door systems, utilizing materials including brass, zinc, resins, stainless steel, aluminum, wood, steel, plastics, glass, and vinyl. Core capabilities include product innovation in water management and connected products, digital shower systems, smart home locks, and outdoor living materials. The company emphasizes automation, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data-driven manufacturing processes to enhance productivity and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include kitchen and bath dealers, wholesalers oriented toward builders and professional remodelers, industrial and locksmith distributors, do-it-yourself remodeling-oriented home centers, showrooms, e-commerce retailers, and other retail outlets. Major customers include The Home Depot (11.7% of 2022 net sales) and Lowe's Companies (12.0% of 2022 net sales). The company serves residential new construction, repair and remodel, and security markets, with approximately 27% of net sales to U.S. home centers and 20% to international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in North America and China, with significant presence in the United States (80% of 2022 net sales), Canada (8%), China (8%), and other international markets (4%). Manufacturing facilities are located in 8 U.S. states, Mexico (4 facilities), Europe (4 facilities), Africa (4 facilities), Asia (1 facility), and Canada (1 facility). The company maintains 52 distribution centers and warehouses worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fortune Brands operates across multiple supply chain positions. The company manufactures a significant portion of products sold and also sources finished goods from third-party manufacturers. The company acquires raw materials and components from numerous suppliers and vendors in various countries, maintaining both direct manufacturing operations and sourcing partnerships. The company emphasizes global supply chain excellence and strategic sourcing to leverage scale efficiencies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include building leading business and brand positions in attractive growth categories, developing innovative products and processes for customers and consumers, and building an aligned organization using the Fortune Brands Advantage operating model. Key focus areas include water management, connected products, outdoor living, sustainability, material conversion, and safety and wellness. The company invests in digital transformation, e-commerce capabilities, data science, and connected product development to drive growth and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of branded home and security products sold through multiple channels including direct sales forces, independent manufacturer representatives, wholesalers, home centers, mass merchandisers, retailers, industrial distributors, specialty dealers, and e-commerce platforms. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of products to customers, with variable consideration adjustments for customer programs, incentives, and rebates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In Water Innovations, competitors include Masco, Kohler, LIXIL Group, InSinkErator (Whirlpool), Huida, Hgill, and Jomoo. In Outdoors & Security, competitors for doors include Masonite, JELD-WEN, Andersen, Trex, Azek, Plastpro, and Pella; for locks, competitors include Abus, W.H. Brady, Hampton, Allegion, and Assa Abloy; for safes, competitors include Magnum, Fortress, and Interlocks. The company positions itself as a leader with market-leading brands, sustainable competitive advantages, and strong innovation capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2022, the company reported net sales of $4,723.0 million (down 1.6% from 2021's $4,801.1 million) and operating income of $774.3 million (down 4.5% from 2021's $811.1 million). Net income attributable to Fortune Brands was $686.7 million in 2022 compared to $772.4 million in 2021. During the three-year period 2020-2022, net sales grew at a compounded annual rate of 11.8% and operating income grew at 14.2%. The company had total assets of $6,120.9 million and total equity of $2,086.9 million as of December 31, 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes market-leading brands with sustainable competitive advantages, a diversified mix of distribution channels, lean and flexible supply chains, and a strong capital structure. Key differentiators include a long track record of successful product and process innovations introducing valued new products that save water, utilize recycled materials, conserve energy, and protect people. The company leverages the Fortune Brands Advantage operating model consisting of category management, business simplification, global supply chain excellence, and digital transformation to drive competitive differentiation and customer value.
